subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3324
title: Provides that a health care facility is not a manufacturer, distributor, seller or lessor of a product for purposes of a product liability civil action if the health care facility was not involved in the design or manufacture of the product.
headline: HB 3324 did not pass
